title: MOTION (SOTO-MARTINEZ for RAMAN - YAROSLAVSKY) relative to funding for the installation of wooden shoulder railing along a portion of Mulholland Drive…
text:
[Council File 26-0011-S27; CD 4]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (SOTO-MARTINEZ for RAMAN - YAROSLAVSKY) relative to funding for the installation of wooden shoulder railing along a portion of Mulholland Drive adjacent to Laurel Canyon Mulholland Park located near 8100 Mulholland Drive in Council District 4.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $59,601 in the Council District 4 portion of the Council Discretionary Street Furniture Fund No. 43D, Dept. 50 to the General Services Fund No. 100/40, as follows: $50,995 to Account No. 001014 (Salaries, Construction) and $8,606 to Account No. 003180 (Construction Materials) for the installation of wooden shoulder railing along a portion of Mulholland Drive adjacent to Laurel Canyon Mulholland Park located near 8100 Mulholland Drive.
2. AUTHORIZE the General Services Department to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
